form.label: BigFix Maintenance Tools
form.description: Monitors database cleanup operations, endpoint lifecycle, and BESTools performance across Audit, Computer, and Health cleanup utilities.

panel.title: Total Database Rows Purged Over Time

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:bestools" "removed" "rows" | rex field=_raw "BES (?<Tool>Computer Remover|Audit Trail Cleaner|Health and Cleanup) removed (?<rows_deleted>\d+) rows" | search Tool="*" | timechart span=1d sum(rows_deleted) AS "Rows Purged" by Tool

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:bestools" ("Total number of expired Computers:" OR "Total number of Computers affected:" OR "Total Number of Duplicated Computers:") | rex field=_raw "Total number of expired Computers:\s+(?<Expired>\d+)" | rex field=_raw "Total number of Computers affected:\s+(?<Inactive>\d+)" | rex field=_raw "Total Number of Duplicated Computers:\s+(?<Duplicated>\d+)" | timechart span=1d max(Expired) AS Expired, max(Inactive) AS Inactive, max(Duplicated) AS Duplicated

drilldown.link: search?q=search index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:bestools" ("Total number of expired Computers:" OR "Total number of Computers affected:" OR "Total Number of Duplicated Computers:")&earliest=$earliest$&latest=$latest$

panel.title: BES Health and Cleanup - Action Expirations

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:bestools" "Total number of expired or stopped actions" | rex field=_raw "Total number of expired or stopped actions :\s+(?<Stopped_Actions>\d+)" | timechart span=1d max(Stopped_Actions) AS "Stopped/Expired Actions Cleaned"

drilldown.link: search?q=search index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:bestools" "Total number of expired or stopped actions"&earliest=$earliest$&latest=$latest$

panel.title: Top Tables Contributing to Database Bloat (Audit Trail Cleaner)

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:bestools" "Number of rows in" "table:" | rex field=_raw "Number of rows in (the )?(?<Table_Name>[^\:]+) table:\s+(?<Row_Count>\d+)" | search Table_Name="*" | stats sum(Row_Count) as "Total Rows Cleaned" by Table_Name | rename Table_Name AS "SQL Database Table" | sort - "Total Rows Cleaned" | head 15
